claims.statement: The selected Fire roster consists of the exact live DJ, EK, and FL sequence sources in diamond mode.
The player walks one continuous S from the Water door to the Earth door, horseshoeing 240 degrees around each of three isolated performers through a separate entry and exit mouth.
Walked courts cool to coals behind the visitor, all red extinguishes, and only then does the green Earth route appear along the route already walked.

checks.name: canon-conflicts
checks.evidence: The production contract records the revived S-procession and isolates the 58 by 44 metre candidate from the undersized live shell.

checks.name: source-digests
checks.evidence: The Gate 1 report locks the plan, live sequence binding, catalog, and generated board digests.

checks.name: sequence-fingerprints
checks.evidence: Exact JDJD, KEKE, and LFLF catalog fingerprints and live word parity are recorded above and in the Gate 1 report.

checks.name: live-motion-capture
checks.evidence: Gate 2 walk frames 2, 4, and 5 capture the three live rigs with their sequence and catalog identifiers legible on screen: cave-fire-seq-dj/tnd-split-opp-jdjd, cave-fire-seq-ek/tnd-split-opp-keke, cave-fire-seq-fl/tnd-split-opp-lflf.

evidence.note: Board panel 1: the measured 58 by 44 metre plan with the single S from Water to Earth.
Board panel 3: lane into one rock, elevations in metres.
Board storyboard strip: arrival, DJ walked, EK walked, blackout, Earth growth.
checks.performersHiddenUntilTheMouth, measured per court from its approach point.

checks.name: walkability
checks.evidence: A 0.5 metre grid flood fill from the Water threshold reaches every court mouth, every orbit arc, and the Earth door with no isolated cell. One continuous S across 15 numbered path sections.

checks.name: clearance
checks.evidence: Perpendicular ray marches prove a 3 metre minimum walkable width everywhere, 4.5 metres on the lanes and court throats. The rejected hub interior narrowed to the corridors that read as claustrophobic.

checks.name: final-view
checks.evidence: Board storyboard state 5 and the report's redAbsentBeforeGreen check: the last view is the Earth door with the green route tracing the walk already taken, and no red anywhere.

checks.name: sightlines
checks.evidence: Segment intersection proofs from each court approach show the next performer occluded by basalt until the visitor turns into that court mouth.

checks.name: separate-entry-and-exit
checks.evidence: tests/unit/museum/first-fire-blender-contract.test.ts asserts every court has a distinct entry and exit mouth, so the visitor can never leave a court the way it was entered.

approval.quote: It brings me around a corner and I cannot see EK which is fine I like that Let's start gate three
approval.note: Austen read the space correctly from the walk: the horseshoe turn occludes the next court until its mouth, which is exactly what the sightline-study measured.

evidence.note: Headless Blender build driven entirely by the approved plan contract.
Seven walk frames captured at 1408 by 792 from https://localhost:5173/test/first-fire-graybox, walk-01 through walk-07 in the same directory.

checks.name: artifact-digest
checks.evidence: scripts/verify-first-fire-graybox-glb.mjs passes: 156792 bytes, one scene, 151 nodes, 15 materials, Draco plus GPU instancing, no QA cameras or lights, and the report digest matches the coordinate manifest.

checks.name: collision
checks.evidence: Fire never owns collision: the walk player collides with basalt and court walls only. 24 lane flames plus 36 court perimeter flames equals 60 anchors, all pass-through, all placed from the contract.

checks.name: route-duration
checks.evidence: The single S from the Water door to the Earth door is walkable end to end. tests/unit/museum/first-fire-graybox-review.test.ts carries both a ribbon walk and an ordinary sloppy walk through all three courts to fire-extinguished, and completes a court at its exit mouth when the sweep was not tracked.

checks.name: sequence-parity
checks.evidence: The review mounts the real MuseumPerformerStation3D. Walk frames 2, 4, and 5 show the live rigs with their sequence and catalog identifiers legible: cave-fire-seq-dj/tnd-split-opp-jdjd, cave-fire-seq-ek/tnd-split-opp-keke, cave-fire-seq-fl/tnd-split-opp-lflf.

checks.name: staged-reveal
checks.evidence: The verifier asserts every green mesh carries the runtime staged FF_Growth prefix. Walk frames 1 to 6 contain no green; frame 7 shows the Earth route only after the last fire is out.

approval.quote: I think we're really on the right track and I'm pretty happy with the Gray box now. What's the next major phase?
approval.note: Approval confirmed by the later walk report, where Austen described the horseshoe turn and the occluded EK court from his own play session.
